events.title: The Gesualdo Six – Wishing Tree
events.description: Experience a captivating evening of contemporary and renaissance vocal music performed by the renowned British a cappella ensemble, The Gesualdo Six, as part of Musica Viva Australia's season. Expect intricate harmonies and a strong artistic atmosphere.

events.title: Al Jardine and The Pet Sounds Band
events.description: Join Al Jardine, a founding member of The Beach Boys, and his Pet Sounds Band for an evening of classic hits and timeless music. Expect a nostalgic and high-quality live performance.

events.title: 360 ALLSTARS
events.description: A high-energy urban circus showcasing world champion athletes and artists in disciplines like breakdancing, BMX, basketball freestyle, and drumming. This non-stop show blends street culture with incredible artistry.

events.title: PRAMKICKER by Sadie Hasler
events.description: A contemporary theatre production by Sadie Hasler, known for its insightful and often humorous exploration of human behavior and societal issues. Expect a thought-provoking and intimate theatrical experience.

events.title: The Rocketman in Concert
events.description: A live concert paying tribute to the iconic music of Elton John, featuring a full band and orchestral arrangements. Expect a high-energy performance celebrating classic hits.

events.title: BEETLEJUICE THE MUSICAL
events.description: The Broadway hit musical based on Tim Burton's classic film, featuring quirky characters, dark humor, and catchy songs. This is your last chance to see the spectacular production in Brisbane.

events.title: Opera Queensland Rusalka
events.description: Experience Dvořák's enchanting opera, Rusalka, presented by Opera Queensland, telling the mythical tale of a water nymph who longs to become human. A sophisticated performance with strong artistic and emotional depth.

events.title: Olafur Eliasson: Presence
events.description: An immersive art exhibition by renowned artist Olafur Eliasson, exploring themes of perception, environment, and our relationship with the world through light, movement, and natural phenomena. Attracts curious and thoughtful visitors.

events.title: Morning Art Riser for Olafur Eliasson: Presence
events.description: Enjoy early morning access to the Olafur Eliasson: Presence exhibition before public opening hours, offering a more intimate viewing experience of the immersive artworks. Ideal for those who prefer smaller crowds and quiet contemplation.

events.title: Volunteer Guided Tour Olafur Eliasson – Presence
events.description: Join a volunteer guide for an insightful tour of the Olafur Eliasson: Presence exhibition, gaining deeper understanding of the artworks and the artist's concepts. Offers opportunities for discussion and learning in a small group.

events.title: Behind the Scenes Talk Presence
events.description: A talk offering an in-depth look at the making and conceptualisation of the Olafur Eliasson: Presence exhibition, often featuring curators or experts involved in the installation. Perfect for those interested in the artistic and technical aspects of large-scale art.

events.title: First Nations Art Tours
events.description: Explore Indigenous Australian art at GOMA with an expert guide, learning about the stories, artists, and cultural significance behind the works. Offers a thoughtful and enriching cultural experience.

events.title: Artist in Residence: Martin Edge
events.description: Witness artist Martin Edge at work in his studio residency, observing his creative process and potentially engaging in informal discussions about his art. Offers a unique insight into contemporary art practice.

events.title: Artist in Residence: Renee Kire
events.description: Observe Renee Kire during her artist residency, gaining insight into her artistic methods and themes. This offers a chance to see art being created and potentially interact with the artist.

events.title: Inala Multicultural Festival
events.source: Inala Community House / Brisbane City Council
events.description: A vibrant community festival celebrating the diverse cultures of Inala through food, music, dance, and cultural performances. A great opportunity to experience local culture and connect with the community.

events.title: Free guided tours - Brisbane Botanic Gardens Mt Coot-tha
events.datetime: Mon 29 Jun – Sat 4 Jul, 11:00 AM & 1:00 PM
events.location: Mt Coot-tha Visitor Information Centre, Toowong
events.description: Join a volunteer guide for an informative walk through the Brisbane Botanic Gardens, learning about the diverse plant collections and their history. A grounding outdoor experience with social interaction and knowledge sharing.

events.title: Free guided tours - City Botanic Gardens
events.datetime: Mon 29 Jun – Sat 4 Jul, 11:00 AM & 1:00 PM
events.location: City Botanic Gardens Information Kiosk, Brisbane City
events.description: Explore the historical City Botanic Gardens with a knowledgeable volunteer guide, discovering its significant trees, collections, and stories. A relaxed social outing in nature, perfect for learning and conversation.

events.title: Camellias in Focus
events.location: Botanic Gardens Auditorium, Brisbane Botanic Gardens Mt Coot-tha, Toowong
events.description: An event dedicated to camellias, likely featuring displays, expert talks, and perhaps plants for sale or demonstrations on care. A great opportunity for gardening enthusiasts to learn and connect.

events.title: Yaggara Kakka Brisbane NAIDOC 2026
events.description: Celebrate NAIDOC Week at this significant community event, featuring First Nations cultural performances, stalls, workshops, and educational activities. A chance to engage with Indigenous culture and history.

events.title: Dating Disasters
events.description: A comedy or cabaret show exploring the humorous and often awkward side of modern dating, presented as part of the Wynnum Fringe festival. Expect an entertaining and relatable performance.

events.title: Voyages to the Underworld: UQ Centre for Western Civilisation 2026 Winter School
events.description: An intensive winter school exploring themes related to "the underworld" through the lens of Western Civilisation, offering lectures, discussions, and potentially workshops. This program provides deep intellectual engagement on historical and philosophical topics, including accommodation.

events.title: groundwork: 50 years of art, artists, education and community
events.description: An exhibition celebrating 50 years of art, artists, and community engagement at the UQ Art Museum, showcasing a rich history of artistic and educational contributions. Offers a deep dive into local art history and institutional impact.

events.title: Shady Nasty (AUS) with blue diner. & Koady
events.description: Catch an intimate gig featuring Australian indie artists Shady Nasty, supported by blue diner. and Koady, known for their unique sounds and energetic live performances. A chance to discover new music in a vibrant setting.

events.title: Spiderbait (AUS) with Custard & The Gnomes
events.description: Iconic Australian indie-rock band Spiderbait performs live with support from Custard and The Gnomes. Expect a night of high-energy rock and nostalgic hits from these beloved acts.

events.title: Cradle of Filth + DevilDriver (UK/USA)
events.description: A heavy metal double-header featuring UK black metal legends Cradle of Filth and US groove metal band DevilDriver. Appeals to authentic subcultures and offers a powerful live music experience.
